chunks: Ibn Abi Umeyr narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

A man came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I am destroyed!' He (peace be upon him) said to him, 'The wicked one (Satan) came to you and said to you, 'Who created you?' So you said, 'Allah.' Then he said to you, 'Who created Him?' So he said, 'Yes, by the One who sent you with the truth, it was so.' So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said, 'That, by Allah, is pure faith.'

Ibn Abi Umeyr said, 'So I narrated that to Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, and he said, 'My father narrated to me from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) meant by his words, 'This, by Allah, is pure faith,' fearing that he might have been destroyed because that occurred to him in his heart.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the question 'Who created Allah?' in Shia theology?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, this hadith from *Al-Kafi* distinguishes between mere intellectual speculation and the 'pure faith' (*mahd al-iman*) that remains intact despite the mind's tendency to over-analyze. The secondary narration by Ibn Abi Umayr highlights the concept of *khawf al-halaka* (fear of destruction), indicating that while the logical paradox of 'Who created Allah?' is a natural cognitive occurrence, it does not necessarily negate faith unless it solidifies into persistent doubt. This underscores the Shia emphasis on the stability of the heart's conviction over the fluctuations of rational inquiry.

en.hubeali:
Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘A man came over to the Prophetsaww and he said, ‘O Rasool-Allahsaww! I am destroyed!’ So hesaww said to him: ‘The wicked one (Satanla) came to you and hela said to you, ‘Who Created you?’ So you said, ‘Allahazwj’. So hela said to you, ‘Who Created Himazwj?’’ So he said, ‘Yes, by the Oneazwj Whom Sent yousaww with the Truth, it was such’. So Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘That, by Allahazwj, is purity of the Emān’.

Ibn Abu Umeyr (the narrator) said, ‘So I narrate with that to Abdul Rahman Bin Al-Hajjaj, and he said, ‘Abu Abdullahasws narrated to me that Rasool-Allahsaww, rather, meant by hissaww words: ‘This, by Allahazwj, is purity of the Emān’, fearing him that he happened to have persihed were that was displayed to him in his heart’.
en.sarwar: Ibn abu ‘Umayr has narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “Once a man came to the Holy Prophet and said, ‘O Messenger of Allah, I am destroyed,’ and the Messenger of Allah said, ‘Has the filthy one come to you and asked you, “Who has created you?” and you said, ‘Allah has created me,’ and he said, “Who has created Allah?” The man said, ‘Yes, by the One Who has sent you with the truth, it was just as you said. ’ The Messenger of Allah said, ‘That by Allah is pure belief.’

Ibn abu ‘Umayr has said that I told this to ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj and he said that his father narrated to him from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “By saying, ‘This by Allah it is pure belief the Messenger of Allah referred to his fear of temptation and to the degree that he thought it (soul’s such tale telling) is destructive.’”
